title: 5.3 Drinks
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Recognize and name drinks and five common drinks, say who is drinking them, and say what I drink with drink.
grammar_function: The grandmother is drinking tea. I drink water in the morning. Do you drink coffee? Yes, I do.
prerequisite: 1.2 drinking; 1.4–1.6 family; 4.5 in the morning; 4.8 Do questions/replies; 5.2 food.
speaking_outcome: Name a drink and say what I drink in the morning.
